nativeProtocol.acceptance: In every scenario no pipe, tank or pump ever holds a foreign fluid (every fluid segment read every tick), no fluid box of a machine is ever joined to the pipes of two fluids except through a pump, and no recipe-switching machine ever holds a recipe none of its rules asks for. At the published caps every product reaches its cap from empty, the four mall groups in list order, and keeps flowing while all chests are emptied every second; the rocket fuel section makes 12 a minute (within 0.25) over thirty minutes with coal, its calcite, sulfuric acid and water at the figures on their panels, while the mall part is full and idle and while it fills from empty, and its chest stops at exactly its cap. At reduced caps (a tenth, at least 2) the mall refills after complete collection, recovers after a five-minute outage of every input, holds full stock for an hour without a craft, follows cap edits, and with each outside input withheld from a cold start still fills every product that does not need it and the rest after the input returns; it fills every cap after being built piece by piece in ten orders (two of them by construction robots), after five minutes without power, after an hour with the stone exit blocked, after an hour of thin lava or thin calcite, after lava, calcite or either lava foundry was cut in mid-run, and when placed turned or mirrored; and no recipe change of a recipe-switching foundry puts a fluid into another network. Imported blueprint unchanged in every scenario.
